title: Resolving the H₀ and S8 Tensions Through Local-Global Inference Separation: An Energy-Flow Cosmology Analysis
abstract: The Hubble tension and S8 tension represent the most significant challenges to LCDM. We demonstrate that both tensions can be resolved simultaneously through entropy-dependent modification of local-to-global parameter inference within the EFC framework.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Resolving H0 and S8 tensions via entropy-dependent coupling

key_results: H0 tension resolved with chi-squared improvement of 40.29
S8 tension reduced from 3.3 sigma to 0.3 sigma
BAO, SNe Ia, and CMB distance constraints fully preserved
Effective gravitational coupling G_eff(S) = G_N(1 + beta*S) with beta < 0
